exposure: passage of the biparietal diameter (BPD) of the infrapubic line (IPL)
percentage of head after the IPL
distance between the widest diameter of the head and the IPL
percentage of head beyond the IPL
cohort: 45 term singleton pregnancies with prolonged 2nd stage of delivery with cephalic presentation
finding: Translabial ultrasound measurements, particularly the distance between the widest diameter of the fetal head and the infrapubic line, and the percentage of head beyond the infrapubic line, can predict the success and difficulty of operative vaginal delivery.
